prompt: compare order books across NSE:RVNL, NSE:NCC and NSE:KIRLOSENG - which one has the strongest revenue visibility? include the new orders each has won since their last concall

assertions.text: Reports a current order book figure for all three companies
Figures match the ledger: RVNL ~₹1,05,085 Cr, NCC ~₹87,079 Cr, KIRLOSENG ~₹798 Cr
